query:
SELECT empresaSlug, 
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Avulso/Clube',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Serv.Extra',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Auxiliar',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Keune',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Don Alcides',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Caixinha',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Barbiero',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Bar',
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))),2) as 'Recorrencia'
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI')
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
